title: SmartAutomator - AI Voice+Vision Automation Framework
description: AI-powered automation framework with voice+vision assistant. Auto-selects between API and UI automation. Three script generation modes (prompt, screenshot, recording) plus interactive voice assistant with guide/do/ask modes. Features: screen capture with change detection, push-to-talk voice I/O (Whisper + TTS), transparent visual overlay pointer, desktop control via pyautogui with humanizer, self-healing selectors, and conversational AI brain. No POM needed.
features: Push-to-talk voice input with silence detection
Continuous screen capture with change detection
Humanizer (Bezier mouse, Gaussian delays, realistic typing)

sample_input.description: Voice or text command to the assistant
sample_input.example: smart-automator assist 'Open Chrome and go to LinkedIn' --mode do

sample_output.example: Mode: DO | Speech: 'Opening Chrome and navigating to LinkedIn' | Actions: open_app(chrome), navigate(linkedin.com) | Duration: 4.2s | Status: SUCCESS
